notes.title: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory Out For Windows/Mac on October 22nd!
notes.notes: [p]Started in 1994, the cult classic Avernum series is one of the great video game sagas. On October 22, Spiderweb Software returns to this unique underworld nation with Avernum 4: Greed and Glory! Coming for Windows and Mac. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]Take a look here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]In this new, epic fantasy role-playing adventure, you explore and save (or betray?) an enormous underworld nation. Battle through huge dungeons, fight unique and cunning foes, collect, create, and bless hundreds of different artifacts, and enjoy a really cool story. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Avernum is a nation deep underground, full of huge caves, treacherous labyrinths, and fairylands of alien fungi. Once a prison, it has won its freedom and is now reaching for wealth and glory. However, old enemies from the deepest caves envy Avernum's growing power. You will have to fight to save this new, fragile land (or be well paid to betray it).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]You can see an Avernum 4 trailer, screenshots, and plenty of information on our web site or on our Steam page. If you are interested, please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]wishlist the game on Steam[/url]. It helps a lot! [/p]

notes.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation, New Spiderweb RPG, Coming March 27!
notes.notes:
Spiderweb Software's next epic adventure is coming out on March 27, 2024! Geneforge 2 – Infestation is a truly open-ended fantasy adventure in a unique world of alien fantasy. You are one of the Shapers, wizards with the awesome power to create life. Want a tool, a trap, an army? You summon it into existence. You create mighty beasts, and they totally obey you. Usually.

But your people have grown lazy and complacent, and a threat has appeared. Your creations are no longer content to serve you. You are lost in a wild, savage mountain range. A rebellion is growing there, and it offers you awesome power if you join. Will you use your powers to destroy the rebels or aid them? Bring peace or lead them to war? The choices are all yours!

To see the trailer and wishlist Geneforge 2, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2480560/Geneforge_2__Infestation/]go here[/url]!

Geneforge 2 – Infestation offers unmatched freedom in how you play. Fight alone with blades, missiles, or magic, or create your own army of custom-made mutant monsters. Alternately, use trickery, diplomacy, and stealth to win the game without ever attacking a foe. There's no 'bad guy'. Choose between a host of rival factions or just destroy everything.

Geneforge 2 is an epic fantasy adventure with almost ninety zones to explore, 50+ hours of gameplay, and huge replayability. Choose from dozens of spells, weapon skills, abilities, and creations to make to reach a vast array of different endings. The rebellion has begun. Awesome wealth and power is yours for the taking. What will you do?

Geneforge 2 – Infestation is a total remaster of our 2003 cult-classic Geneforge 2. It contains new areas, quests, characters, and dialogue, a redone interface and systems, and a complete reworking of every single thing to bring it into the modern era of gaming.

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor Updated to v1.0.3!
notes.notes:
We've released an update to Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor. It fixes a few minor but annoying bugs.

[list]
[*] A few infinite faction farming exploits have been fixed.
[*] Certain magic weapons have the haste bonus that they should.
[*] Some other minor tweaks and typo fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation Kickstarter Launched!
notes.notes:
We have [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation]launched a Kickstarter[/url] for our next title, a full remaster of Geneforge 2, released wayyyy back in 2003. Geneforge 2 - Infestation will be the second chapter in the reborn Geneforge Saga. We want to go over it and redo everything, adding new characters, quests, monsters to create, and training paths to scorch (or save) the mountains of Drypeak.

We’re really excited about the remasters. The first one, Geneforge 1 - Mutagen, is our best-selling game in a long time, and its follow-up will have a lot of fun new stuff to keep the series fresh for newcomers and old fans alike. The Kickstarter will run for a month, and it has a mix of old and new stretch goals and rewards. Backers can still add content to the game (an experiment which has been a huge success), and, for the first time, you can now get physical Spiderweb merch.

We can only still make our odd little games with the support of our fans, and we're hugely grateful. Come check out the new Kickstarter here ...

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation

- Jeff Vogel
Spiderweb Software

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor v1.0.2 is out!
notes.notes:
We've released a major patch for our indie, retro RPG Queen's Wish 2. It fixes a wide variety of issues, major and minor.

* Added cheat code “pleasedontsteal”. Resets all theft levels back to 0, in case the Ro are mad at you. Press Shift-D to enter a cheat code.
* A rare case where the Geld Nad test could be broken has been fixed.
* A bug that kept you from starting combat when no foes are around has been fixed.
* Puzzle boards will no longer misbehave when you select an empty space first.
* A final confrontation has been made a little easier.
* It is no longer possible for the Mistglen final fight to get stuck as peaceful.
* When you end the game early, you don’t learn as much about what was REALLY going on.
* Many other tweaks, typo corrections, and exploit fixes.

Thank you everyone who has supported the game!

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor v1.0.1 is out!
notes.notes:
We've released the first patch for our indie, retro RPG Queen's Wish 2. It fixes one urgent bug and provides a few other happy tweaks.

* The screen locking up when the gameplay area is set to Small has been fixed.
* A rare crash when entering Mistglen is fixed.
* Terrified Mercenaries now escape properly. Whew!
* A variety of minor tweaks and typo fixes.

Thank you everyone who has supported us!

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2 Developer Livestream!
notes.notes:
Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor is the second chapter in the indie, epic Queen’s Wish Trilogy, just released for Windows and Mac. 

You are royalty of the Empire of Haven. A routine diplomatic mission in a brutal, barbarian land has turned into bloody chaos. Fight to calm your subjects, or hunt for a way to set them free.

Explore a vast nation full of cities, forts, and dungeons. Fight clever, carefully designed turn-based battles. Deal with misbehaving vassals with bribery, diplomacy, or violence. Build new forts and customize them, choosing among upgrades that give your adventurers powerful bonuses.

Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor is coming to Windows and Macintosh at the end of Summer, 2022. Progress you make in the demo will carry over to the full game, so you won't need to start over!

The livestream is done by the developer, who has been making retro indie fantasy adventures for 28 years. Come see the game, ask questions, and hear a variety of cranky opinions about the game industry.
